steps.question: Using the rounded RSEM count matrix and metadata (condition: treated n=6 vs control n=6, unpaired, single batch), which of the 12000 genes are differentially expressed between treated and control colon samples, run on all 12 samples per the T1S1 QC recommendation?

Independent filtering and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR applied; results table has baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, padj for every gene
Log2 fold changes shrunk via apeglm or ashr (both available) rather than reported raw

steps.name: Sensitivity DESeq2 treated vs control excluding sample_01
caveats: Dropping a sample reduces one group from n=6 to n=5, further lowering power; a gene losing significance here may reflect power loss rather than sample_01 driving a false positive, and the write-up must distinguish the two
steps.question: Does removing sample_01 (library size ~4x below median) from the treated-vs-control comparison change which genes are called differentially expressed, i.e. is the primary gene list from T1S2 robust to this single low-depth outlier?
acceptance_criteria: Re-runs the identical DESeq2 model (design ~condition, apeglm/ashr shrinkage) on the 11 remaining samples (whichever group loses sample_01)
Reports the overlap (Jaccard or simple intersection count) between the T1S2 and T1S3 significant gene sets at the same padj/log2FC thresholds
States plainly whether the primary conclusions depend on sample_01's inclusion, and if so, which specific genes flip significance

steps.name: Pathway enrichment of DE genes
caveats: WikiPathways/Reactome/Hallmark GMTs use HGNC symbols matching the counts.csv gene-symbol column directly; confirm symbol matching rate before interpreting enrichment, since any unmapped or outdated symbols silently drop from the background
GO/pathway hierarchies are nested; do not report every significant term as an independent finding
steps.question: Which biological pathways and processes are enriched among the genes differentially expressed between treated and control colon samples (from T1S2, cross-checked against T1S3)?
acceptance_criteria: Runs over-representation analysis (or fgsea preranked on the full DESeq2 stat/log2FC-ordered gene list) against Homo sapiens WikiPathways, Reactome, and MSigDB Hallmark gene sets staged locally
Reports enriched terms with FDR-adjusted p-values, and collapses redundant/nested GO or pathway hits rather than reporting a raw uncollapsed count
Explicitly notes which enriched terms are supported only by genes that are inconsistent between the T1S2 (full-cohort) and T1S3 (sample_01-excluded) DE gene lists

plan.title: Colon treated vs control DE with RSEM count QC
plan.analytical_narrative: The matrix holds RSEM gene-level expected counts (12,000 genes x 12 samples: 6 treated, 6 control, unpaired, single batch) with two data-quality issues flagged in the profile that must be handled before any comparison is trustworthy: (1) RSEM expected counts are non-integer and were summarized without the per-sample genes.results effective-length files, so the standard tximport average-transcript-length offset cannot be built and counts must instead be rounded to nearest integer before feeding a count-based negative-binomial model; (2) sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median, which is large enough to distort size-factor estimation and to sit as a leverage point in a 6-vs-6 design where losing even one sample changes power materially. The plan therefore front-loads QC (library size, PCA/sample correlation, outlier assessment) as a gating step whose output determines whether sample_01 is dropped or retained-with-caveat before DESeq2 is run, rather than silently either including or excluding it. DESeq2 (already staged, Bioconductor 1.52.0) is used for the primary treated-vs-control test with rounded counts as integer input, standard median-of-ratios size factors (robust to one aberrant library as long as it is not so extreme it fails normalization, which the QC step checks explicitly), and apeglm/ashr shrinkage (both staged) for interpretable fold changes. Results are checked in a sensitivity re-run excluding sample_01, since the primary run's inclusion of a 4x-shallow library is a real threat to validity that must be quantified, not assumed away. Significant genes then feed pathway enrichment using WikiPathways, Reactome, MSigDB Hallmark/GO human gene sets available locally (all restricted to Homo sapiens, matching the organism of the data) via fgsea/clusterProfiler, giving biological context to the DE gene list. No drug, safety, or clinical-response angle is stated in the research question, so no translational steps are added.
